413:t_3:123.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to know more... About women... About $$エイミー$$.」

413:t_3:125.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, too.」

413:t_10:4.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, huh... Looks like I worried you too.」

413:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems you've come back a notch bigger.」

413:t_10:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't think a body grows in about a week...」

413:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is not what I meant. According to a book from a certain publisher, a human can also make themselves look enormous through the intimidating presence of fighting aura.」

413:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The spirit you showed, $$レド$$, when you took down that fake Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ all by yourself was more than enough for that.」

413:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z that was born at that moment... I will add it to the unit's stock.」

413:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... My apologies. The matter of Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ is a delicate one, isn't it.」

413:t_10:12.en:
$$レド$$
「...Now, I can't know what the Lieutenant Colonel was thinking, or how he came to that way of thinking...」

413:t_10:13.en:
$$レド$$
「But I rejected it. So that I can live as a human.」

413:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Admirable. I look forward to your growth from here on, $$レド$$.」

413:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a human, please produce many $$Ｚチップ$$s through joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure.」

413:t_10:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「Stay away from the Captain, pirate!」

413:t_10:23.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh? I only came to see the face of the formidable woman who took my title, and this is the greeting I get?」

413:t_10:24.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hehe... With such a cute face, one that couldn't kill a single fish, you certainly did a number on me.」

413:t_10:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That was a military operation, so...」

413:t_10:26.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Don't be so frightened. I... don't dislike cute girls, you know.」

413:t_10:27.en:
$$パラエム$$
「Won't you join us, too...」

413:t_10:28.en:
$$パリヌリ$$
「And serve Lady $$ラケージ$$?」

413:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But doesn't it feel rather good? Being finally back, I mean.」

413:t_10:33.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a pilot support and enlightenment interface. It possesses no function called 'mood'.」

413:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$レド$$ has changed from a soldier into a human, so you too will need to change.」

413:t_10:35.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That proposal is approved. Furthermore, this unit already knows how to demonstrate transformation.」

413:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, here we go! Let's get fired up today too...」

413:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Splendid! $$チェインバー#pilot$$ is growing as well.」

413:t_10:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Skeptical proposal. What meaning is there in making each member of $c say this word?」

414:t_000:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... How is the equipment $$ピニオン$$ prepared for us?」

414:t_000:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「No problems with use. This unit's combat power is projected to improve by 20%.」

414:t_000:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#robot$$ approaching.」

414:t_001:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「$$レド$$... Bringing a new order to this planet is our mission.」

414:t_001:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You have no intention of returning to my command... Then.」

414:t_002:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I have mobilized part of my fleet's strength. With this, I will bring you down.」

414:t_002:1.en:
$$レド$$
「And this still isn't all of it...!」

414:t_002:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Approaching energy mass confirmed.」

414:t_003:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Serves you right! Don't think everything will always go your way!」

414:t_003:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah, $$レド$$! This is the treasured beam cannon I tuned up!」

414:t_003:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Leave this side to me and $$フランジ$$! Thanks to you taking that Sacred Idol out of there, we might actually pull this off!」

414:t_003:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Reinforcements will reach you soon, too! I'm counting on you to handle the Sacred Idol, $$レド$$!」

414:t_005:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh my, how unseemly of me! Do pardon me!」

414:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「The female pirate from back then...!」

414:t_005:2.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You may leave this side to me. Boy, you take the Sacred Idol, all right?」

414:t_005:5.en:
$$レド$$
「This planet belongs to this planet's people! You, who can't understand that, are the foolish human!」

414:t_005:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$! I will stop you!」

414:t_006:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Hey, $$レド$$... Why don't you change this planet together with me...」

414:t_007:0.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm going all in! Latch on, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

414:t_008:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Emergency release signal! Force $$ストライカー#robot$$'s hatch open!」

414:t_009:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Having you around is a help...」

414:t_009:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「How about it... Will you... com...e wi...th... m...e... a...gain......」

414:t_009:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Attitude control system, rebooting.」

414:t_010:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was already dead... Then... that $$ストライカー#robot$$ is...」

414:t_010:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. Your resistance is meaningless.」

414:t_010:2.en:
$$レド$$
「No way...! Then who I've been talking to until now was...!」

414:t_010:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「You will be eliminated.」
